blocks.text: Any person not complying with the provisions of this chapter shall be ineligible to receive a City license to conduct or carry on the business of a secondhand dealer under the provisions of Chapter 5.140 TMC. (Code 1981 § 38-105. Code 1995 § 114-160.)
